doc.title: Size Changeover, Line 2 (2 L and 500 ml)
doc.file: SOP-104 Size Changeover Line 2 2 L and 500 ml.pdf
doc.purpose: Change Line 2 between the 2 L and the 500 ml fabric softener bottle.

roles.name: Shift Lead
roles.does: Releases the line for changeover and signs the record.

tools.name: Change parts kit
tools.where: 4.0 Safety and materials (stored in the maintenance crib)

references.as_written: WI-210 Filler Setup and Nozzle Check
WI-212 Labeler Setup and Label Roll Change
SOP-105 Product Changeover and Line Clearance

parameters.quote: Set the application torque to 15 in-lb, plus or minus 2.
Check three bottles with the torque tester.
6 per case for 2 L, 12 per case for 500 ml
6 per case for 2 L, 12 per case for 500 ml
adjust the guide rails to the bottle width plus 3 mm on each side.
Target changeover time: 45 minutes in either direction.

rules.statement: The Maintenance Technician removes locks and tags after the changeover.
rules.quote: Maintenance Technician: Remove locks and tags as described in SP-402.

rules.statement: The Shift Lead releases the line for changeover and signs the record.
rules.quote: Releases the line for changeover and signs the record.
